title: The Canadian Shield Is Hiding Something Nobody Talks About
description:
The Canadian Shield covers half of Canada, and almost nobody notices it. Under this ancient slab of rock is the oldest stone on Earth, water that's been sealed underground for two billion years, and a gravity anomaly so real it's been measured from space. This video covers how an ice sheet that melted 10,000 years ago left a permanent dent in Earth's gravity, why a crater in Sudbury made a city rich, and what scientists found living in total darkness a mile underground.
Topics covered:
The Acasta Gneiss, the oldest rock on Earth
The Sudbury impact crater and its mining legacy
SNOLAB and the neutrino discovery that won a Nobel Prize
The 2-billion-year-old water found near Timmins, Ontario
Why Hudson Bay has measurably weaker gravity
Whale bones buried far from the ocean
If you're into forgotten places and buried Canadian history, subscribe for more.
